rows: Task start: open it in the Customer Approaching File, search the member Username or UID.
Locate the record before anything else.
After locating the record: UID correct, correct customer account, correct brand.
After customer info: the code the customer entered matches the code assigned in the system.
Do not conclude expiry from the error alone.
After code check: Claimed means already claimed; Expired means check whether it has actually expired.
Read the status, do not assume.
Before any escalation: Event > Redeem Code > Redeem Code Payout; enter the code.
Status "approved" means the member already claimed it.
After all checks: escalate to ATL only when eligible + correct code + not claimed + system still shows S0403.
ATL step is for confirmed faults only. Use the escalation template.
Most cases resolve at the CS step.

Standardise the verification sequence before a redeem code fault is escalated, so that only genuine system faults reach the Assistant Team Leader.
Applies when a player confirmed to be on the eligible list cannot redeem their assigned code and gets an "Expired" or "Invalid" (S0403) response.

x: Complete all verification steps before escalating. The ATL step is for confirmed faults only.
Do not conclude a code is expired from the error alone; verify eligibility, the assigned code, status and claim first.
Escalate only when all four escalation criteria are confirmed.

body.x: Escalate to the ATL only when ALL of these are confirmed:

x: System still shows S0403 / Invalid or Expired

body.x: Provide all of the following to the ATL:

UID: [uid]
Brand: [brand]
Redeem Code: [code entered]
Error: Invalid or Expired
Code assigned in system: [assigned code]
Issue: Customer is eligible and entered the assigned code, but the system
still returns an Invalid/Expired (S0403) error. Please assist to verify.
Most cases resolve at the CS step (wrong code, not eligible, or already claimed). Only a genuine S0403 fault, with everything else confirmed correct, reaches the ATL.
